messages:
zoe: Hi all  quick question about therapy sessions I started last week (2026-08-10). My benefits effective date is 2026-09-01. I used the company EAP for an initial consult yesterday and paid for one private session out-of-pocket. Can I get reimbursed or is EAP the only option? cc @lisa :wave:
benefits-bot: Enrollment note: benefits effective date 2026-09-01. Redwood EAP provides up to 3 free counseling sessions independent of carrier coverage. For coverage/reimbursement of out-of-pocket therapy, submit receipts to Expensify using category `healthcare-reimbursements` for a retro review. See: https://redwood.intranet/benefits/mental-health :link:
lisa: Hi Zoe  welcome and thanks for asking. Short version: 1) EAP sessions are free and do not require your medical coverage. 2) If you had therapy outside EAP and the service date is before your carrier effective date, we can attempt a retro review with the carrier or consider an ad-hoc reimbursement in certain situations. Please upload the itemized receipt from the therapist (including provider name, license type, NPI if available) and any session notes that list date of service.
zoe: Thanks. For Expensify, should I mark it as mental-health vs healthcare? Also worried about privacy on the receipt  can I redact diagnosis text?
notice: (system) Reminder: follow privacy redaction rules when uploading medical docs.
ben-payroll: Use category `healthcare-reimbursements`. In the description add `new-hire retro mental health request` if applicable. You may redact sensitive clinical notes or diagnosis fields; keep provider name, date of service, service code or description, and amount. If provider refuses to itemize for privacy reasons, a signed provider statement with date and charge works too.
care-coach: Quick EAP note: If you haven't already, book EAP first-contact at care@redwood-eap.com or call 1-800-555-1212. They can often make a referral to an in-network therapist while your carrier effective date is pending. Also EAP sessions do not count against FSA/HSA limits.
zoe: I paid $120 for a session with a licensed therapist who isn't in-network. Uploaded Expensify ER-33001 and opened ticket #PO-5022. Receipt shows therapist name, license LCSW, date 2026-08-12, amount $120. I redacted clinical notes.
benefits-bot: Ticket PO-5022 logged. Benefits admin will review carrier retro eligibility and advise on possible discretionary reimbursement. Expected response 3 business days.
lisa: Thanks Zoe  I see ER-33001. Two things to note: 1) carrier retro approvals for out-of-network providers are less common but sometimes approved if service falls within a new-hire window and provider meets licensing criteria. 2) If carrier denies and you requested company reimbursement, People Ops can evaluate under our new-hire ad-hoc policy (usually for initial short-term care). That reimbursement is taxable if processed as a discretionary payroll payment.
zoe: Understood. If carrier approves, will refund be non-taxable?
ben-payroll: Yes  if processed as a benefits reimbursement tied to the plan (carrier approval), it's non-taxable and paid via vendor transaction. If we issue an internal discretionary payment or payroll advance, tax treatment may vary and payroll will notify you.
care-coach: Also FYI: if you have an HSA and the service was paid pre-HSA effective date, HSA cannot reimburse prior non-eligible expenses unless the HSA was already open and funded. If you plan to use FSA, those claims need vendor submission to the FSA administrator, not Expensify, unless we process ad-hoc.
lisa: Good point. Zoe, do you have EAP intake confirmation? If not, we'll flag the ticket to coordinate a referral so future sessions might be covered in-network once benefits start.
zoe: I did EAP intake yesterday  referral code REF-778. Should I attach that to the Expensify report?
ben-payroll: Yes please attach EAP referral and any statement showing EAP usage; that helps show you tried the employer-provided resource first.
lisa: Copying a recommended Expensify description to paste:
````
Provider: Private Therapist (Jane Doe, LCSW)
Date of service: 2026-08-12
Service: Psychotherapy (50 min)
Amount: $120.00
Category: healthcare-reimbursements
Attachments: itemized receipt (redacted clinical notes), EAP referral REF-778
Notes: New-hire retro mental health reimbursement request; benefits effective 2026-09-01. Please escalate to benefits admin for carrier retro review. If carrier denies, please evaluate under new-hire discretionary reimbursement policy.
````
zoe: Done  ER-33001 updated with EAP referral and ticket PO-5022. Appreciate the quick help :heart:
benefits-bot: Benefits admin assigned to PO-5022. We'll update this thread with outcome.
lisa: If you want privacy, you can also email me directly and I'll handle docs via secure HR channel. Otherwise we'll coordinate here.
zoe: I'll DM you the files too  thanks again :pray:
